Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 5  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error in their analysis by concluding that "Under the Hawthorn Tree" came out earlier. The Planner incorrectly compared the release dates by normalizing across cross-region year discrepancies using only month and day, disregarding the year entirely. This led to the mistaken conclusion that a film released in 2010 came out earlier than a film released in 1965, simply because of the month-day comparison (09-15 vs 11-26). The correct approach should have considered the full date, including the year, where 1965 is clearly earlier than 2010.
